heading: About Dashvanth Healthcare
sub: East Delhi's trusted multispeciality healthcare centre — expert care, honest pricing, zero wait for emergencies
story: Dashvanth Healthcare was founded with a singular mission: to bring multispeciality hospital-quality care to the doorstep of East Delhi families — without the intimidating environment, long waiting times, or hidden charges of large hospitals.

Located in Krishna Nagar Extension, we serve families from across East Delhi — Vivek Vihar, Shahdara, Preet Vihar, Mayur Vihar, Krishna Nagar, and beyond. Our centre combines expert consultants, an in-house diagnostics lab, 24×7 pharmacy, and digital X-ray & ultrasound under one roof.
